name: Bath
title: Holidays in Bath
intro: Roman baths, golden Georgian crescents and natural hot springs you can still swim in. Here's what Bath is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: Pulteney Bridge and the weir on the River Avon in Bath

facts.label: Entry
facts.value: No passport checks within the UK

facts_note: UK and Irish citizens don't need a passport to travel within the UK, but airlines ask for photo ID. Most other visitors need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA), so check the rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: May, June and September are the best months for walking the city in mild weather. September has the Jane Austen Festival, with a costumed promenade through the streets. From late November to mid December, the Christmas market fills the streets around the Abbey. Summer is busy with day trippers. A soak in the rooftop pool at Thermae Bath Spa works in any weather.

things.name: Roman Baths
things.blurb: The steaming Great Bath and temple ruins, almost 2,000 years old. Children love the audio guide.

things.name: Thermae Bath Spa
things.blurb: Swim in natural hot spring water in a rooftop pool with views over the city. Over-16s only.

things.name: Royal Crescent
things.blurb: A sweeping curve of Georgian townhouses. No. 1 Royal Crescent is a museum of how they lived.

things.name: Bath Abbey
things.blurb: Climb the tower for views over the rooftops and the Roman Baths below.

things.name: Jane Austen Centre
things.blurb: The story of Jane Austen's years in Bath, with tea in the Regency tearoom.

things.name: Stonehenge
things.blurb: The stone circle is about an hour away by car or tour bus, and Wells and Glastonbury are close too.

faqs.question: How many days do you need in Bath?
faqs.answer: Two days is enough to see the Roman Baths, the Royal Crescent and the Abbey and soak in the spa. Add a day for Stonehenge or the Cotswolds.

faqs.question: Can you swim in the Roman Baths?
faqs.answer: No, the Roman Baths are a museum. You can swim in the same hot spring water next door at Thermae Bath Spa.

faqs.question: When is the Bath Christmas Market?
faqs.answer: It usually runs from mid November to mid December, with wooden chalets around Bath Abbey.

faqs.question: How do you get to Bath?
faqs.answer: Trains from London Paddington take about 90 minutes. Bristol Airport is about 45 minutes away by car or airport bus.
